main_text.head: PRÆFATIO, Operis originem ac rationem exponens.
ALMÆ ACADEMIÆ LVGDVNO-BATAVÆ GERARDVS ET ARNOLDVS BOTII, FRATRES, IPSIVS QVONDAM ALUMNI, S. P. D.
main_text.p: VUm in illustri Gymnasio Ultrajectino, ubi non tantùm utriusq; Lingua, sed & Artium Liberalium cognitio diligenter traditur, & in quo nos studiorum tyrocinium posuimus; post perceptam Linguam Latinam atq; Græcam, & Rhetorico quoq; ac Logico stadio decurso, ordine ad Rerum Naturalium disciplinam pervenissemus: una cum eâ magna quoq; Aristotelis admiratio nobis instillata fuit, tanquam Naturæ summi adeoq; unici Mystæ, nihilq; prælectum aut expositum, quàm quod ex ipso haustum esset; neq; quicquam æque inculcatum, quàm despere quicunq; ob eo in Naturæ investigatione discordarent: quorum propterea vix nomina nobis tunc cognoscenda putavimus, nedum ut scripta eorum nobis tractanda aut vel inspicienda existimaremus. Hoc in Aristotelem studium, atq; reliquorum, qui ab eo dissentirent, aversatio, duravit nobis etiam, postquam in tuum, Alma Mater, sinum nos recepimus, atq; ibi Hippocrati ac Galeno nos in Medicinæ disciplinam tradidimus. page.notes: Woodcut initial Q with a figure in an oval frame; the initial letter is read as Q. Transcription of the opening word "VUm" reads as "Cum" with the large initial. The word "stant" at the foot right is the final word of the page, not a catchword in the strict sense; the last line is incomplete and continues on the next page. Some faint speckles and marks in the margins are not printed text.
